### Delete this file before merging probably!

### Load Libraries

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

### Loading the data

```{r}

patients <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load_patients.tsv")) 
samples <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load_samples.tsv")) 
mutations <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load_mutations.tsv"))
```

### Data Inspection

```{r}
# Overview of dimensions and column types
glimpse(patients)
glimpse(samples)
glimpse(mutations)

# Group patients by category
patients |> count(AGE_GROUP, SEX, OS_STATUS, DRUG_TYPE)

# Check if these columns are constant in samples
samples |> count(SAMPLE_CLASS, INSTITUTE, SOMATIC_STATUS)

# Check remaining categorical columns in samples
samples |>
  select(SAMPLE_TYPE, METASTATIC_SITE, GENE_PANEL) |>
  map(table, useNA = "ifany")

# Check constant/status columns in mutations
mutations |>
  select(Center, NCBI_Build, Variant_Classification, Variant_Type, Validation_Status, Mutation_Status) |>
  map(table, useNA = "ifany")
```

### Cleaning Code for the three tables

```{r}
# 1. Clean patients (keeping original column names)
patients_clean <- patients |>
  separate_wider_delim(
    OS_STATUS,
    delim = ":",
    names = c("OS_EVENT", "OS_STATUS")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    OS_EVENT  = as.integer(OS_EVENT),
    OS_STATUS = str_to_lower(OS_STATUS),
    SEX       = factor(SEX),
    AGE_GROUP = factor(AGE_GROUP, levels = c("<30", "31-50", "50-60", "61-70", ">71")),
    DRUG_TYPE = factor(DRUG_TYPE)
  )

# 2. Clean samples (keeping original column names, converting "default" to NA first)
samples_clean <- samples |>
  mutate(
    METASTATIC_SITE = if_else(
      METASTATIC_SITE %in% c("Not Applicable", "Not available"),
      NA_character_,
      str_to_title(METASTATIC_SITE)
    ),
    METASTATIC_SITE = str_replace(METASTATIC_SITE, "Lypmh", "Lymph"),
    TUMOR_PURITY    = as.numeric(if_else(TUMOR_PURITY %in% c("default", "N/A"), NA_character_, TUMOR_PURITY)),
    GENE_PANEL      = factor(GENE_PANEL),
    SAMPLE_TYPE     = factor(SAMPLE_TYPE),
    SOMATIC_STATUS  = factor(SOMATIC_STATUS)
  ) |>
  select(-SAMPLE_CLASS, -INSTITUTE)

# 3. Clean mutations (keeping original column names)
mutations_clean <- mutations |>
  mutate(
    Mutation_Status = na_if(Mutation_Status, "UNKNOWN")
  ) |>
  select(-Center, -NCBI_Build, -Validation_Status, -Score, -ALLELE_NUM, -IS_NEW)
```

### Cleaning Verification

```{r}
# 1. Verify AGE_GROUP factor levels didn't create unexpected NAs
patients_clean |> count(AGE_GROUP)

# 2. Verify structure and types of all three cleaned tables
glimpse(patients_clean)
glimpse(samples_clean)
glimpse(mutations_clean)
```

### Save Clean Data

```{r}
write_tsv(patients_clean,  here("data", "02_dat_clean_patients.tsv"))
write_tsv(samples_clean,   here("data", "02_dat_clean_samples.tsv"))
write_tsv(mutations_clean, here("data", "02_dat_clean_mutations.tsv"))
```

# Data wrangling

```{r}
# Pick 5 major cancer driver genes to investigate
target_genes <- c("TP53", "KRAS", "PIK3CA", "BRAF", "PTEN")

# Filter mutations_clean to only those 5 genes and keep unique sample-gene pairs
# (distinct prevents counting a patient twice if they have 2 mutations in TP53)
gene_status <- mutations_clean |>
  filter(Hugo_Symbol %in% target_genes) |>
  distinct(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Hugo_Symbol) |>
  mutate(MUTATED = "Mutated")

# Join patients_clean and samples_clean first (1-to-1 by PATIENT_ID)
# Then join with every combination of sample and target gene so unmutated patients get "Wild-Type"
gene_survival <- patients_clean |>
  inner_join(samples_clean, by = "PATIENT_ID") |>
  crossing(Hugo_Symbol = target_genes) |>
  left_join(gene_status, by = c("SAMPLE_ID" = "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Hugo_Symbol")) |>
  mutate(MUTATED = replace_na(MUTATED, "Wild-Type"))

# Survival time (OS_MONTHS) for Mutated vs. Wild-Type across each gene
ggplot(gene_survival, aes(x = MUTATED, y = OS_MONTHS, fill = MUTATED)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Hugo_Symbol, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall Survival by Driver Gene Mutation Status",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Overall Survival (Months)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
